$comment: Ticket → test → implementation mapping, read by scripts/check-test-first.mjs.
One entry per test file, added in the `test:` commit of its ticket and left
unchanged afterwards. `implementation` lists only source files this ticket
CREATES; the checker proves none of them existed at the commit where the test
file was first added. A file that already exists and is only modified goes
under `touches`, which the checker ignores — listing it under `implementation`
fails the check, because the ordering would not be provable (plan §6.2, D-17).
Kept as a top-level object with an `entries` array so that metadata can be
added without breaking the checker. An empty array is valid and exits 0.
